offices.title: Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha (MP)
offices.desc: Drafts central laws, codes frameworks, and reviews national assembly policies.

offices.title: Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA)
offices.desc: Direct provincial representative working inside legislative assemblies.

offices.title: Member of Legislative Council (MLC)
offices.desc: Upper tier review panels active strictly within bicameral states.

offices.title: Sarpanch (Gram Panchayat Head)
offices.desc: Leads the village council, implements rural development schemes, and manages local resources.

offices.title: Gram Panchayat Ward Member (Panch)
offices.desc: Directly elected representative of a village ward. Votes on local development plans and beneficiary selection for welfare schemes.

offices.title: Panchayat Samiti Member
offices.desc: Represents a block-level constituency and coordinates developmental plans across multiple villages.

offices.title: Block Pramukh (Panchayat Samiti President)
offices.desc: Executive head of the intermediate block council who approves and allocates rural funding.

offices.title: Zila Parishad Member (District Councillor)
offices.desc: Represents district-level territorial constituencies and shapes macro rural development policies.

offices.title: Zila Parishad Chairperson / President
offices.desc: Chief executive of district rural governance, overseeing substantial state and federal development funds.

offices.title: Municipal Corporator / Councillor
offices.desc: Directly elected ward representative who votes on city budgets, zoning, and urban public health.

offices.title: Mayor
offices.desc: Ceremonial or executive head of a large city corporation presiding over municipal general body meetings.

offices.title: Nagar Panchayat Chairperson
offices.desc: Heads governance for semi-urban transitional areas, directing local sanitation and street infrastructure.

offices.title: Autonomous District Council Member
offices.desc: Elected in specialized tribal zones under the 6th Schedule to legislate on land, custom, and local culture.
